texts.zh:

基恩将军听您吩咐。我是超然均衡教团的一位特使。我被派遣来帮助所有需要消除暴政的人。接纳我的誓言，我的武力将为你所用。
texts.en:
The warrior is armed with advanced weaponry and armor. Scans reveal extensive biological modifications and cybernetic enhancements.

General Jynn, at your service. I am an envoy of the Numinous Equilibrium. I have been sent to defend those in need and help bring about the end of tyranny. Accept my oath, and I shall put my arms at your service.
